story_zh: 春天天气非常晴，白花长高了。夏天太热，红太阳很高。秋天天气阴，黑云很多。冬天下雪，雪很白，天气非常冷。我喜欢四季的天气。
story_pinyin: Chūntiān tiānqì fēicháng qíng, báihuā zhǎng gāo le. Xiàtiān tài rè, hóng tàiyáng hěn gāo. Qiūtiān tiānqì yīn, hēi yún hěn duō. Dōngtiān xià xuě, xuě hěn bái, tiānqì fēicháng lěng. Wǒ xǐhuān sìjì de tiānqì.
story_en: In spring, the weather is very sunny, and white flowers grow tall. Summer is too hot, and the red sun is very high. In autumn, the weather is cloudy with many black clouds. Winter brings snow; the snow is white, and the weather is very cold. I like the weather of all four seasons.
